caption:
Figure 1. Unlike conventional point cloud completion that aims
to recover individual points (middle, non-planar points shown in
red), parametric completion recovers primitive parameters along
with corresponding inlier points. PaCo recovers planar structures
(right, each color denoting a planar primitive), directly enabling
high-quality polygonal surface reconstruction.
